name: lyrika
description: Лирика — synced Russian lyrics with transliteration, translation and an ocean stage

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @lyrika/shared && concurrently -n shared,server,client -c yellow,cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @lyrika/shared" "npm run dev -w @lyrika/server" "npm run dev -w @lyrika/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @lyrika/shared && npm run build -w @lyrika/server && npm run build -w @lyrika/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @lyrika/shared && npm run typecheck -w @lyrika/server && npm run typecheck -w @lyrika/client
